# LOGIC4 harness bitstream format (as-built, experimental)

> **Status: experimental, as-built harness format. NOT the ratified-fabric
> format.** It documents the G1 harness fabric exactly as generated by
> FABulous 2.2.0 (one LOGIC4 tile plus CAP boundary cells). ADR-0004 and
> ADR-0005 are still Proposed, so the ratified fabric's bitstream is not
> defined here and `spec/framework-gaps.md` G6 remains **OPEN**.

<!-- GENERATED by flow/gen_bitstream_format.py from `sim/bitstream/logic4_configmem.map` and `sim/bitstream/fabric_spec.json`; do not edit.
     Regenerate: python3 flow/gen_bitstream_format.py -->

Tile `X1Y1` has 158 config bits: 68 BEL bits (4 BELs x (16 LUT INIT + 1 `reg_sel`)) and 90 switch-matrix select bits, in 5 used frames of 32 bits. `cfg[i]` is line `i` of the config-bit map; its frame position is `32*frame + bit`. The serialized frame stream is described in `sim/README.md` ("Serialized format"); this file only lists what each bit means.

## Switch-matrix mux encodings

The select pattern is written with the lowest cfg index first (the order of the cfg bits in each heading). A destination is driven by the source whose pattern matches. Sources absent from a destination's list have no connection; patterns not listed are unassigned.

|---|---|
| `N1END0` | `000` |
| `S1END0` | `100` |
| `W1END0` | `010` |
| `LA_O` | `110` |
| `LB_O` | `001` |
| `LC_O` | `101` |
| `LD_O` | `011` |
